name: Designpull
summary: Chrome extension that generates Google Stitch compatible DESIGN.md files from any website using your own AI vision key.
description: An open source Chrome extension: it visits any website, captures a full-page screenshot plus computed CSS tokens, and sends both to your chosen AI provider (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude or Ollama) to write a DESIGN.md. The output follows the Google Stitch DESIGN.md specification and covers colors, typography, spacing, layout, photography style, components, brand voice and site-specific do's and don'ts. No backend, no account; API keys stay in the browser.
contains: full-page scroll capture or current-view capture
12 output sections incl. overview, colors, typography, spacing, elevation, components, brand voice, do's and don'ts
providers: Gemini, OpenAI, Claude and Ollama (local, free)
API keys stay in the browser; zero backend, no account
history keeps the last 20 generated files
platform detection flags Squarespace, Webflow and Shopify internals
